name: Arkansas River — Stone Bridge to Rincon (Salida)
blurb: CPW Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area: Class II–III water from Stone Bridge through Salida (low-head dam and whitewater park) into upper Bighorn Sheep Canyon to the Rincon ramp.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: 19.5-mile CPW AHRA section through Salida. Review the dam, bridge and whitewater-park notices below. No reviewed float-time estimate is available.

notices.title: Park pass
notices.text: CPW AHRA: a Colorado State Parks daily or annual pass is required at AHRA fee sites (Stone Bridge and Rincon are fee sites).

notices.title: Salida low-head dam
notices.text: The CPW safety map identifies a low-head dam near mile 59 and a boat chute on river left. Scout and review current agency guidance before attempting passage.

notices.title: River hazard
notices.text: CPW AHRA safety map: Stone Bridge (mile 52.3, CR 191) may require a portage above 4,000 cfs at the Nathrop gauge; portage river right.

notices.title: Whitewater park
notices.text: CPW AHRA safety map: the Salida Whitewater Park begins at mile 61.5 — expect hanging slalom gates and congestion around the play hole at the Salida boat ramp.

putInAccess.note: CPW AdminData facilities (FeatureServer/0), feature 3566 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 32 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: CPW AHRA fee site with boat ramp/slide (CPW Buena Vista–Salida sites page); a daily or annual Colorado State Parks pass is required at AHRA fee sites (CPW AHRA brochure). (CPW AHRA Buena Vista–Salida sites, https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area-buena-vista).

takeOutAccess.note: CPW AdminData facilities (FeatureServer/0), feature 3400 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 4 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: CPW AHRA fee site with boat ramp/slide; CPW: 'a takeout for boaters wanting a more mellow float'; a daily or annual Colorado State Parks pass is required at AHRA fee sites (CPW AHRA brochure). (CPW AHRA Salida–Vallie Bridge sites, https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area/arkansas-headwaters-recreation-area-salida-vallie). Imagery check 2026-10-26 (Esri World Imagery + USGS NHDPlus HR): Pin at the river-side lobe of the gravel lot, about 20 m from the water's edge; HR named flowline 25.5 m.

gaugeContext.note: Colorado DWR measures discharge at Salida within this reach. The CPW Stone Bridge portage threshold specifically refers to the upstream Nathrop gauge; do not apply it to this Salida reading. This reading does not establish safe passage through the low-head dam or whitewater park.

flowSource.name: Arkansas River at Salida
flowSource.note: Colorado DWR operates this active station within the Stone Bridge–Rincon reach. Provides current discharge context while upstream USGS Nathrop is seasonal; no timing calibration is added.

mapAuditNote: Audited 2026-10-26. Every endpoint is an exact managing-agency facility point within 150 m of the USGS NHDPlus centreline.
